rules.text: Documentation-only proposed first macOS developer preview release plan. Current full gate remains unchanged without explicit owner approval. Review for contradictions, unapproved gate changes, misleading source/performance or release claims, missing core safety/distribution blockers, unbounded loops, unrealistic unconditional promises, and failure to deliver a consumable SDK as well as the application. This is a proposal, not an already executed release. Existing 33.3ms cutoff failed; no performance experiment is requested. Relevant prior source evidence is linked. Focus actionable material issues. Prior review found missing allocation for R4 and a possible soak invalidation after runtime fixes. Final plan now allocates R1 0.5/R2 0.5/R3 1/R4 0.5/R5 0.5 sessions totaling 3, plus maximum 1 contingency, and explicitly reruns soak and affected lifecycle checks after runtime fixes. Check these corrections and remaining material contradictions.
